svg.title: Compare Base Rates Without Hiding Other Charges
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-07-storefront-base-rate-comparison; chapter number: 4; title: Compare Base Rates Without Hiding Other Charges; subtitle: Percentage charges are only one part of the storefront decision.; caption: Smart Capital reports 10% Gumroad commission and 5% on Payhip Free. Stack Receipts uses 5% plus $0.50 for Lemon Squeezy. Job4all reports 8% plus $0.40 for Notion Marketplace.; assumptions note: Smart Capital, Stack Receipts, and Job4all describe separate platform alternatives. The percentages are not additive, the low and high values repeat each quoted base rate, and fixed charges and processing are not converted into invented effective-rate estimates.; note: Smart Capital explicitly separates commission from processing. Stack Receipts specifies a domestic-card example. Job4all also mentions foreign exchange and possible refund or chargeback costs. These reported schedules are not promises of current platform terms.; chart type: stacked_comparison; unit: Percent of sale; independent platform alternatives; total range: Quoted base percentage rates span 5%–10%; do not sum the alternatives; buckets: label: Gumroad commission; low: 10; high: 10; notes: Smart Capital reports 10%, equivalent to $2.90 on its $29 template example, before processing.; label: Payhip Free platform charge; low: 5; high: 5; notes: Smart Capital reports 5%, equivalent to $1.45 on its $29 example, before processing.; label: Lemon Squeezy base percentage; low: 5; high: 5; notes: Stack Receipts applies 5% plus $0.50 to its $20 domestic-card example and reports $18.50 in proceeds.; label: Notion Marketplace percentage; low: 8; high: 8; notes: Job4all reports 8% plus $0.40 per transaction, with foreign-exchange and possible refund or chargeback costs discussed separately.
